title: Leaked passwords
summary: Learn about how Service NSW protects your MyServiceNSW Account and what to do if your passwords are potentially compromised.
intro: Your security is our priority. We use the latest technology to better protect your MyServiceNSW Account and identity information from cyber criminals.

external_links.text: practical guidance on protecting your devices

internal_links.text: Protect your personal information with Service NSW
Cyber security, identity theft and scams

faqs.a: A leaked password is a password that has been exposed or found in a data breach.

faqs.q: When will Service NSW notify me about leaked passwords?
faqs.a: Service NSW will notify you if we find that your password has been leaked.

faqs.q: What should I do if I am prompted to change my password?
faqs.a: You should change your password immediately if prompted by Service NSW.

faqs.q: How can I keep my password secure?
faqs.a: Keep your password secure by using strong, unique passwords and setting up multi-factor authentication.
